# The declared floor of every package a CI leg installs — Core plus `optica[test]`.
#
# Plan § "Tech Stack" → *Keeping current* requires the matrix to test the
# minimum **and** maximum declared versions of what each leg installs, because
# testing only the latest can never catch use of an API that is absent from the
# lower bound. The `max` legs install whatever resolves today; the `min` leg
# installs this file.
#
# Each pin is the lowest release that satisfies the corresponding `>=` bound in
# `pyproject.toml` — verified against PyPI on 2026-09-21, see
# `notes/verified.md` § "Every declared lower bound is a real release".
# A bound moved in `pyproject.toml` must be moved here in the same commit.

typer==0.27.0
rich==15.0.0
python-dotenv==1.2.0
pydantic-settings==2.15.0
httpx==0.28.0
pillow==12.3.0

# optica[test] — the non-user-facing toolchain
